summary: The fix-2 character light removes the round-2 blocker. Fighters keep their painted value structure: units_gate value spread is min 41.5 / median 56.1 L* (r2 15.5 / 23.8). In my own A/B crops, fighters with W2-A on and with the switches off look almost the same, and in greyscale they separate from the lifted ground. The whole-frame read is good on all three maps. The ground is calm and mid-value, lanes, river and jungle are told apart, and walls show a lighter top than face. Matrix, value_probe, flash, telegraph and lilac gates all pass. One Done-when line fails: units_gate still FAILs, with 27 fails. Against the wave-1 src tree on the same art (25 fails) that is mixed. P3 improved 3 -> 0. P2 regressed 0 -> 2 (odrum and nurrow tops now sit in the enemy/harm band), P4 went 6 -> 8 and lilac went 28.9 -> 26.4 (still at least 25). Ruling 49, which the code and tokens cite, is not written.
